card.name: Country or place names before institutions
card.fires_on: Country or place names (Canada, US, Russian, County, town) that modify or name a place-based thing, such as universities or portals, in general web text. It also fires weakly on a few unrelated words.

modes.label: Country before institution
modes.description: A nationality or country name right before a noun like universities or university.
modes.example: ACT scores are required by many<< US>> universities and universally accepted for college admission.

modes.label: Country as topic
modes.description: The country name ends a phrase about information on that country.
modes.example: and for information about<< Canada>>. Canadian Health: Healthy living means making

modes.label: Scattered other words
modes.description: Odd single words with no shared theme, such as a place noun or a linking word.
modes.example: Still, it is a unique way to wander around a<< town>>, looking for interesting spots to make into

card.writes: It seems to push toward foreign, exchange and export words, and away from local or unrelated terms.
card.plain: It lights up on country names that point to a nation's own institutions, like US or Russian universities.
